hardware.fabric: four direct ConnectX-7 200GbE RoCEv2 links between the pair; two rails used (one port per card)
hardware.per_link_ceiling: ~109 Gb/s; both ports of one ConnectX-7 share a single PCIe Gen5 x4 link
hardware.storage: NVMe (ext4) for the LMCache L2 tier

image.note: No published runtime image. The runtime is built from source in-container per the recipe repository (CUDA 13.2 toolkit added on top of the base); this profile records configuration and provenance, not a distributable image.

runtime.engine_branch: dev/gilded-gnosis + PR-318 stack (merge 3e6393ae6) + two upstream ports
patches_required: vLLM #51113 port: mamba-align chunk splitting into the fork's diverged scheduler; prerequisite for safe prefix caching on this hybrid model
vLLM #48425 port: per-group prefix-hit divergence reconcile; prevents stale-recurrent-state resume under KV-pressure eviction with a KV connector (LMCache issue 4247)

lmcache 0.5.2 heartbeat fix: scheduler-side _ensure_heartbeat_started guards on `is not None` against a field initialized to {}, so heartbeats never start, servers reap the engine after ~2.5 minutes, and all subsequent lookups silently return 0 while stores keep working

model.architecture: hybrid, 48 GatedDeltaNet + 16 full-attention layers, vision tower, MTP draft head
model.quantization: EXL3 K5/K6 (MLP gate/up K5, down K6; attention K6; lm_head K6; quantized MTP head; BF16 embeddings and vision)
model.kv_pool_tokens_note: Varies ~2% per boot with allocator state (3,893,434-3,973,864 observed at 0.70). 0.40 yielded 1,842,455; 0.55 yielded 2,852,305.

kv_tier.topology: one lmcache MP server per rank (port 6556), lmcache_driven transfer mode
kv_tier.l2_adapter: fs_native on NVMe, use_odirect false, LRU
kv_tier.sizing_note: A lookup counts an L2 hit only after staging chunks into L1, so a prefix larger than L1 returns zero hits silently. chunk bytes per rank = 65 layers x 2 x 1600 tokens x 512 B / TP; ~15,000 replayable tokens per GB of L1 at TP=2, ~7,500 at TP=1.

notable_env.NCCL_IB_SUBNET_AWARE_ROUTING: 0 (required for parallel rails between one rank pair)

benchmarks.notes: Greedy throughout; outputs byte-identical across cold, warm, engine-restart and server-restart states. See RESULTS.md.

decode_matrix_tok_s.note: greedy, GPUMEM 0.70, BATCHTOK 3072, LMCache on, 20s windows

operational_notes.restart_order: kill engine -> cycle lmcache servers -> start engine. The MP servers hold the engine's KV cache through CUDA IPC and do not release it when the engine exits (69 GB observed held by a 4.8 GB-RSS process), so an engine-only restart can fail with 'Free memory on device cuda:0 ... less than desired GPU memory utilization'.
operational_notes.launcher: scripts/start-stack.sh in the recipe repository gates every precondition (ray GPUs free, cache servers listening, heartbeat patch present, weights and patched NCCL on both ranks) and verifies the engine answered before exiting 0.
operational_notes.power_recovery: After a power event the containers restart but rank 0 loses GPU access ('Failed to initialize NVML') and needs `docker restart`; then re-add rail /24s, ray head, ray worker, cache servers, engine.
operational_notes.single_node: TP=1 runs the same stack on one Spark (drops ray, striping, rank-1 cache server). Measured: KV pool 1,669,678 tokens; decode 23.8/43.1/85.2 at 4k ctx and 22.2/42.0/85.3 at 16k for cc1/2/4; prefill 330/398/446/667 at 4k/8k/16k/32k. The LMCache chunk doubles to 213 MB since one node holds every KV head, so L1 must double for the same replay length; lower --max-num-seqs from 64 to suit the smaller pool.
